The real browser download preserved the full generated JSON exactly, including maximum-size numerators and tiny rational values. Approximate strings do not replace report values.
Missing/blocked/malformed reports, prior numerator/denominator caps, invalid negative absolute metric and detached old-button invalidation passed focused regressions.
Expanded large exact code wraps to a bounded cell, and the 320px viewport stayed horizontally contained. Both generated screenshots were visually reviewed.
